name: proposal-similar
title: Similar projects
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Selectable past projects with revenue, duration, hours, and a match bar. The detail compares quoted and actual hours, then a three-column overlap.

files.content:
"use client" /** Clean-room similar-work picker. Cards select; the detail compares phases. */ import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { formatHours, formatMoney, shareRatio } from "@/lib/proposal" export type SimilarPhase = { id: string label: string quoted: number actual: number } export type SimilarProject = { id: string name: string client: string revenue: number weeks: number hours: number /** 0–1 */ match: number phases: readonly SimilarPhase[] } export type SimilarColumn = { id: string title: string items: readonly string[] } export type ProposalSimilarProps = { projects: readonly SimilarProject[] value?: string onValueChange?: (id: string) => void comparison: readonly SimilarColumn[] locale?: string currency?: string revenueLabel?: string weeksLabel?: string hoursLabel?: string matchLabel?: string quotedLabel?: string actualLabel?: string className?: string } export function ProposalSimilar({ projects, value, onValueChange, comparison, locale = "en-US", currency = "USD", revenueLabel = "Revenue", weeksLabel = "Weeks", hoursLabel = "Hours", matchLabel = "Match", quotedLabel = "Quoted", actualLabel = "Actual", className, }: ProposalSimilarProps) { const selected = projects.find((project) => project.id === value) ?? projects[0] return (
{projects.map((project) => { const active = project.id === selected?.id return ( ) })}
{selected ? (

{selected.name}

    {selected.phases.map((phase) => { const max = Math.max(phase.quoted, phase.actual, 1) return (

  • {phase.label}

    • ) })}
) : null}
{comparison.map((column) => (

{column.title}

    {column.items.map((item) => (
  • {item}
    • ))}
))}
) } function Bar({ label, value, width, tone, locale, }: { label: string value: number width: number tone: "muted" | "primary" locale: string }) { return (
{label}
{formatHours(value, locale)}
) }

docs: Clean-room proposal workflow. The behavior was observed in an unlicensed design demonstration of a discovery-to-statement-of-work product. No source, product names, sample copy, icons, or assets were copied. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme.
